INITSECTION
// Generated by tools/build_waypoints.py from waypoints.json: edit that, not this file.
//
// DB_WaypointInfo(group, id, shrine, arrival point) is how the game declares its own
// waypoints (Shared: _Waypoints.txt). The shrine is the invisible object players use;
// what they see is the boulder behind it, with the rune on its face.
//
// The game's rules do the rest: they register a
// waypoint for the map, unlock it when a player comes near the shrine or uses it, and
// lock every waypoint of a group when the story leaves that act.

// The Hollow. Emerald Grove: on the floor of the Hollow, backed into the ledge below Okta's and Auntie Ethel's stalls, across from Dammon's forge
DB_WaypointInfo("Act1","NEW_WAYP_DEN_Hollow",(ITEM)S_NEW_WAYP_DEN_Hollow_Shrine_968d6ac1-6eab-4906-9107-31fa006de392,(TRIGGER)S_NEW_WAYP_DEN_Hollow_Trigger_4a56b43b-456d-4556-8d14-d7f62c62b4e3);
DB_NEW_WAYP_Waypoint("NEW_WAYP_DEN_Hollow");

// Underdark - Arcane Tower. Underdark: on the wall of the Arcane Tower, a few steps from its front door
DB_WaypointInfo("Act1","NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower",(ITEM)S_NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower_Shrine_8b98077f-ef81-4f3b-9b83-a7b8dbc6042a,(TRIGGER)S_NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower_Trigger_5f0acf54-f384-46f5-8565-fb29d2eb1d69);
DB_NEW_WAYP_Waypoint("NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower");

// Sovereign Glut can only follow the party between Underdark waypoints, and the game
// keeps the list of those (Act1_UND_MyconidCircle_BroodingMyconid.txt). These are in the Underdark too.
DB_UND_BroodingSpovereign_UnderdarkWaypoints("NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower");

KBSECTION
//REGION Register for the map
// This goal has no parent, so it starts as soon as the story does, also in a save that
// was made without the mod. Depending on the order in which goals start, that can be
// before the game's _Waypoints goal is running, and its rule only registers a waypoint
// when the DB_WaypointInfo fact is added. Registering once more when gameplay starts
// covers both orders.
IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_, _)
AND
NOT DB_NEW_WAYP_Registered(1)
THEN
DB_NEW_WAYP_Registered(1);
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Register();

PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Register()
AND
DB_NEW_WAYP_Waypoint(_ID)
AND
DB_WaypointInfo(_, _ID, _Item, _)
THEN
RegisterWaypoint(_ID, _Item);
//END_REGION

//REGION Locked together with the game's own waypoints
// Where the story locks one of its waypoints (the Emerald Grove when the druids seal it),
// a waypoint of this mod in the same place is locked at the same moment.
PROC
PROC_LockWaypointForAll("WAYP_DEN_Camp")
THEN
PROC_LockWaypointForAll("NEW_WAYP_DEN_Hollow");

//END_REGION

//REGION Moved: where this version puts them, also in saves made before
// A save keeps where its items and triggers stand, so moving a released waypoint in the mod's
// files would move it in new games only. This puts the shrine and the arrival point of each
// moved waypoint where this version has them: once per save, when the waypoint's level is
// loaded, the way the game's own hotfixes move objects. In a new game they are there already.
IF
LevelLoaded("WLD_Main_A")
AND
NOT DB_NEW_WAYP_Placed("NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower",2)
THEN
DB_NEW_WAYP_Placed("NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower",2);
ToTransform(S_NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower_Shrine_8b98077f-ef81-4f3b-9b83-a7b8dbc6042a,-18.812,32.027,-290.1,0.0,180.0,0.0);
TeleportToPosition(S_NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower_Trigger_5f0acf54-f384-46f5-8565-fb29d2eb1d69,-18.812,32.041,-288.1,"",0,0,0,0,0);

IF
LevelLoaded("WLD_Main_A")
AND
NOT DB_NEW_WAYP_Placed("NEW_WAYP_GOB_Sanctum",2)
THEN
DB_NEW_WAYP_Placed("NEW_WAYP_GOB_Sanctum",2);
